sentiment.rationale: The document reports a severe profit decline (GAAP EPS down 89.2% to $0.39, operating income down 87.0%) driven by inventory reduction actions, and while full-year revenue guidance is reaffirmed at low- to mid-single digit growth, the operating margin guidance for the back half is around 6%, which is a significant reduction from the prior year's 9.8% operating margin rate. The forward guidance is effectively lowered relative to the company's own prior performance, and management's language is cautious ('planning cautiously'), resulting in a bearish sentiment score.

summary.revenue: Total revenue of $26.0 billion grew 3.5% compared with last year, reflecting total sales growth of 3.3% and a 14.8% increase in other revenue.
summary.eps: GAAP diluted EPS of $0.39, down 89.2% from $3.65 in 2021. Adjusted diluted EPS of $0.39, down 89.2% from $3.64 in 2021.
summary.guidance: Full-year revenue growth in the low- to mid-single digit range, and an operating margin rate in a range around 6% in the back half of the year.
summary.margin: Second quarter gross margin rate was 21.5%, compared with 30.4% in 2021. Operating income margin rate was 1.2%, compared with 9.8% in 2021.
key_risks: Higher markdown rates driven primarily by inventory impairments and actions to address lower-than-expected sales in discretionary categories.
Higher merchandise, inventory shrink, and freight costs.
Increased compensation and headcount in distribution centers, costs of managing excess inventory, and higher per-unit last-mile shipping costs.
key_opportunities: Comparable sales grew 2.6 percent, on top of 8.9 percent growth last year, reflecting continued strength in Food & Beverage, Beauty and Household Essentials.
The Company gained unit share in all five of its core merchandising categories in the second quarter.
Digital comparable sales grew 9.0 percent, following growth of 9.9 percent last year.
Same-day services (Order Pickup, Drive Up and Shipt) grew nearly 11 percent this year, led by Drive Up, which grew in the mid-teens.
